cdif:takesValuesFrom.schema:name: Survey missing-value codes
cdif:takesValuesFrom.cdif:purpose: Distinguish the reasons a substantive value is absent so that analysis can treat them differently.

cdi:isDescribedBy.cdi:description: Negative integer codes reserved for non-substantive responses: -97 below detection limit, -98 refused, -99 not applicable. These values are never measurements and must be excluded before any arithmetic.
